entities.summary: Oleksii Yuriyovych Len, commonly known as Alex Len, is a Ukrainian professional basketball player for Real Madrid of the Liga ACB and the EuroLeague. Before being selected in the 2013 NBA draft by the Phoenix Suns, he played two seasons for the Maryland Terrapins as well as a season with Dnipro. Len played twelve seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA).
